theory_families.title: Classical mechanics
theory_families.external_lineage: Newtonian and analytical mechanics; global physics lineage
theory_families.intersection: State evolution under explicit constraints and laws.
theory_families.harmonization: BL can use classical dynamics as a scoped Reality model without treating it as total ontology.
theory_families.disagreement: Classical mechanics is not adequate for relativistic or quantum regimes.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not map deterministic equations to universal metaphysical determinism.

theory_families.title: Classical electromagnetism
theory_families.external_lineage: Maxwellian field theory and experimental electrodynamics
theory_families.intersection: Field-mediated interaction, propagation, measurement and engineering constraints.
theory_families.harmonization: Provides mature examples of representation that directly enables intervention.
theory_families.disagreement: Classical fields do not replace quantum electrodynamics in microscopic regimes.
theory_families.non_merge: Field language must not be reused as evidence for undefined BL fields.

theory_families.title: Thermodynamics
theory_families.external_lineage: Classical thermodynamics; statistical-physics lineage
theory_families.intersection: Constraints, irreversibility, resource budgets and feasible state transitions.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful boundary discipline for BL transformation and actualization models.
theory_families.disagreement: Epistemic uncertainty is not thermodynamic entropy by default.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not equate information loss with physical entropy without a specified mapping.

theory_families.title: Statistical mechanics
theory_families.external_lineage: Boltzmann-Gibbs statistical physics and later developments
theory_families.intersection: Micro-to-macro emergence, ensembles and coarse-grained descriptions.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL study of aggregate patterns without assuming each macro object is fundamental.
theory_families.disagreement: Statistical emergence is not evidence that every high-level BL construct is physically emergent in the same sense.
theory_families.non_merge: Keep physical ensemble semantics separate from metaphorical possibility spaces.

theory_families.title: Special relativity
theory_families.external_lineage: Einsteinian relativity and modern experimental physics
theory_families.intersection: Observer-dependent coordinates with invariant physical structure.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful distinction between perspective-dependent representation and invariant constraint.
theory_families.disagreement: Observer relativity in physics is not unrestricted epistemic relativism.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not translate frame dependence into 'all truths depend on observer'.

theory_families.title: General relativity
theory_families.external_lineage: Einsteinian gravitation and modern relativistic astrophysics
theory_families.intersection: Geometry, causal structure, prediction and instrument-mediated validation.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports scoped discussion of causal structure and observer location.
theory_families.disagreement: GR does not establish controllable backward information transfer.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not convert spacetime geometry into BL future-regression proof.

theory_families.title: Quantum mechanics
theory_families.external_lineage: 20th-century quantum theory and global experimental physics
theory_families.intersection: Measurement, state representation, uncertainty and nonclassical structure.
theory_families.harmonization: BL can preserve quantum constraints as external Reality constraints while exploring epistemic analogies separately.
theory_families.disagreement: Quantum uncertainty is not generic ignorance and entanglement is not generic interconnectedness.
theory_families.non_merge: No quantum metaphor may be promoted to a BL physical claim without formal mapping and evidence.

theory_families.title: Quantum field theory and the Standard Model
theory_families.external_lineage: Quantum field theory, gauge theory, collider physics and CERN/global collaborations
theory_families.intersection: A highly successful scoped model that remains explicitly incomplete outside its domain.
theory_families.harmonization: Strong example for BL local-canonicality without total-closure claims.
theory_families.disagreement: It does not contain gravity or explain all cosmological observations.
theory_families.non_merge: Its incompleteness cannot be used as positive evidence for any particular BL ontology.

theory_families.title: Bell inequalities and quantum entanglement
theory_families.external_lineage: Bell-test experiments; Aspect, Clauser, Zeilinger and quantum foundations
theory_families.intersection: Reality can violate classical intuitions about separability.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful constraint on naive local hidden-variable narratives.
theory_families.disagreement: Entanglement does not permit arbitrary faster-than-light signalling.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not merge entanglement with BL bridge or future-information metaphors.

theory_families.title: Quantum information science
theory_families.external_lineage: Quantum physics plus information theory; NIST and global QIS community
theory_families.intersection: Information has implementation constraints and can be treated as an operational resource.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful for separating abstract information structure from physical carrier constraints.
theory_families.disagreement: Information is not thereby proven to exist independently of physics.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not promote informational language into ontological primacy without evidence.

theory_families.title: Modern observational cosmology
theory_families.external_lineage: Relativistic cosmology, CMB, supernovae, lensing and large-scale-structure programs
theory_families.intersection: Inference from multiple independent observations under model uncertainty.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL separation between observed effect and unresolved underlying ontology.
theory_families.disagreement: Dark matter and dark energy remain unresolved in underlying nature.
theory_families.non_merge: Dark sector must not be relabelled as BL UNKNOWN.

theory_families.title: Atomic and molecular theory
theory_families.external_lineage: Modern chemistry, spectroscopy and quantum chemistry
theory_families.intersection: Composition, structure and transformation depend on representable constituents and relations.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful analogy for BL constituent/relationship separation.
theory_families.disagreement: Conceptual constituents in BL are not physical atoms.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not literalize structural analogy.

theory_families.title: Chemical thermodynamics and kinetics
theory_families.external_lineage: Physical chemistry and reaction dynamics
theory_families.intersection: Possible states, barriers, rates and path-dependence.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL distinction between reachable and merely representable states.
theory_families.disagreement: Reaction-coordinate semantics do not transfer automatically to epistemic search.
theory_families.non_merge: Keep chemical energy barriers distinct from cognitive cost metaphors.

theory_families.title: Crystallography and solid-state structural theory
theory_families.external_lineage: Crystallography, diffraction and solid-state chemistry
theory_families.intersection: Taxonomy is constrained by observed structure rather than inherited definitions.
theory_families.harmonization: Quasicrystal history supports BL ontology revision when repeated evidence breaks a category.
theory_families.disagreement: Category surprise alone does not prove a new ontology.
theory_families.non_merge: Replication and structure determination remain required.

theory_families.title: Two-dimensional materials and graphene
theory_families.external_lineage: Condensed-matter and materials science; Geim, Novoselov and broader field
theory_families.intersection: Structural regime changes can unlock qualitatively new properties without new constituents.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL recombination and architecture-sensitive capability ideas.
theory_families.disagreement: Novel properties remain domain- and material-specific.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not infer universal transformation from dimensional analogy.

theory_families.title: Metal-organic frameworks and reticular chemistry
theory_families.external_lineage: Kitagawa, Robson, Yaghi and reticular chemistry
theory_families.intersection: Designed relational architecture can generate new function from known building blocks.
theory_families.harmonization: Strong engineering analogue for BL structure-first recombination.
theory_families.disagreement: Designed chemical frameworks are not evidence for arbitrary ontology engineering.
theory_families.non_merge: Keep molecular architecture and epistemic architecture distinct.

theory_families.title: Plate tectonics
theory_families.external_lineage: Wegener drift evidence plus seafloor, paleomagnetic and seismic programs
theory_families.intersection: Rejected/incomplete earlier models can preserve valid structure later absorbed by stronger theory.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL negative-knowledge and supersession-with-history rules.
theory_families.disagreement: Vindication of one outsider does not raise the prior probability of all rejected claims.
theory_families.non_merge: Social rejection is not an epistemic credential.

theory_families.title: Earth-system and physical climate science
theory_families.external_lineage: Atmospheric, ocean, cryosphere, paleoclimate and Earth-system sciences; IPCC synthesis
theory_families.intersection: Multi-model evidence, feedbacks, calibrated confidence and conditional futures.
theory_families.harmonization: Strong external template for BL uncertainty and scenario discipline.
theory_families.disagreement: Scenario projection is not backward information from the future.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not convert conditional climate pathways into remembered futures.

theory_families.title: Evolution by natural selection and modern evolutionary genetics
theory_families.external_lineage: Darwinian evolution, Mendelian genetics, population genetics and molecular evolution
theory_families.intersection: Variation, selection, inheritance and path-dependent adaptation.
theory_families.harmonization: Can inform BL evolutionary search metaphors when mapping is explicit.
theory_families.disagreement: Epistemic optimization is not biological fitness by default.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not convert 'selection' language into biological claims without a population/heredity model.

theory_families.title: Mendelian, chromosomal and molecular genetics
theory_families.external_lineage: Mendel, chromosome theory, DNA genetics and genomics
theory_families.intersection: Inheritance, causal history, mutation and lineage.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful structural analogy for BL-ADN provenance, with explicit non-biological status.
theory_families.disagreement: BL genealogy is documentary/conceptual, not genetic heredity.
theory_families.non_merge: Never imply biological descent from symbolic lineage.

theory_families.title: Gene regulation and regulatory networks
theory_families.external_lineage: Molecular biology, transcriptional/post-transcriptional regulation and systems genetics
theory_families.intersection: Context-sensitive control of expression from a shared underlying substrate.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL distinction between stored structure and activated state.
theory_families.disagreement: Conceptual activation is not gene expression.
theory_families.non_merge: Regulatory-network analogy cannot substitute for mechanism.

theory_families.title: Genomics and the Human Genome Project
theory_families.external_lineage: International Human Genome Project and modern genomics
theory_families.intersection: Shared infrastructure and representations can radically expand future question-space.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL knowledge infrastructure and open-data ideas.
theory_families.disagreement: Genome sequence is not a complete causal description of a person.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not collapse genotype, phenotype, environment and identity.

theory_families.title: CRISPR-Cas genome editing
theory_families.external_lineage: Microbial adaptive immunity and genome engineering; Charpentier, Doudna and wider field
theory_families.intersection: Knowledge can cross from representation to targeted intervention.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL separation of know/represent/reach/actualize.
theory_families.disagreement: Editability does not imply full predictability or controllability of organisms.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not equate editable code with editable reality in general.

theory_families.title: Protein structure, folding and computational prediction
theory_families.external_lineage: Structural biology, physical chemistry, CASP, AlphaFold and computational protein design
theory_families.intersection: Prediction can compress search and expose structure before complete mechanistic explanation.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL assisted formalization/prediction without equating prediction with proof.
theory_families.disagreement: Accurate structure prediction is not a complete causal theory of cellular function.
theory_families.non_merge: Prediction quality cannot silently become mechanism authority.

theory_families.title: Microbial causation and infectious-disease mechanisms
theory_families.external_lineage: Germ theory, microbiology, immunology and modern infectious disease
theory_families.intersection: Hidden causal agents can become observable through improved methods.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL anomaly→mechanism→test progression.
theory_families.disagreement: Not every unexplained disease has a microbial cause.
theory_families.non_merge: A successful causal pattern in one domain cannot be generalized without tests.

theory_families.title: Prion biology
theory_families.external_lineage: Prusiner and transmissible-spongiform-encephalopathy research
theory_families.intersection: Evidence can force expansion of a mature causal taxonomy.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL dimension/ontology genesis only when anomalies survive strong testing.
theory_families.disagreement: Taxonomy expansion is evidence-driven, not permission for arbitrary categories.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not use prions as generic proof that any unconventional mechanism is plausible.

theory_families.title: Cellular, circuit and systems neuroscience
theory_families.external_lineage: Neuroanatomy, electrophysiology, imaging and neurotechnology; NIH BRAIN Initiative
theory_families.intersection: Observer resolution and instrumentation determine which scales of cognition become measurable.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL embedded-observer and representation-boundary thinking.
theory_families.disagreement: Circuit mapping does not provide a settled complete theory of consciousness or identity.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not map ANN nodes directly to biological neurons as identity.

theory_families.title: Computability theory and the Church-Turing framework
theory_families.external_lineage: Turing, Church, recursion theory and mathematical logic
theory_families.intersection: Explicit limits on what formal procedures can compute or decide.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL distinction between representation/reachability and guaranteed solvability.
theory_families.disagreement: Computability theory does not prove physical reality is a Turing machine.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not collapse formal computability with ontological possibility.

theory_families.title: Computational complexity theory
theory_families.external_lineage: Theoretical computer science; complexity classes, reductions and hardness theory
theory_families.intersection: Reachable in principle does not imply tractable under bounded resources.
theory_families.harmonization: Directly useful for BL resource-aware search and verification routing.
theory_families.disagreement: Unproven conjectures such as P≠NP must remain open.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not label practical difficulty as formal complexity without a mapping.

theory_families.title: Information theory and coding theory
theory_families.external_lineage: Shannon information theory and modern coding/communication theory
theory_families.intersection: Compression, channel capacity, noise and recoverability.
theory_families.harmonization: Strong formal parent for BL compressed-memory and scar-compression work when quantities are explicitly defined.
theory_families.disagreement: Semantic meaning is not identical to Shannon information.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not use entropy terminology without specifying the random variable/channel/model.

theory_families.title: Modern cryptography
theory_families.external_lineage: Complexity-based cryptography, information-theoretic security and protocol theory
theory_families.intersection: Adversarial knowledge, proof, authentication and bounded disclosure.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL provenance/security boundaries without importing cryptographic guarantees where none exist.
theory_families.disagreement: Conceptual privacy is not cryptographic security.
theory_families.non_merge: No BL policy may be called secure merely by analogy to cryptography.

theory_families.title: Control theory and feedback systems
theory_families.external_lineage: Classical/modern control, estimation and feedback theory
theory_families.intersection: Feedback, state estimation, stability and intervention under uncertainty.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful for BL Reality feedback loops and governor design.
theory_families.disagreement: Epistemic correction is not automatically a dynamical control system with measurable state.
theory_families.non_merge: Stability metaphors require an explicit state and transition model.

theory_families.title: Statistical learning and machine learning
theory_families.external_lineage: Statistics, optimization, pattern recognition and modern machine learning
theory_families.intersection: Generalization, training/evaluation separation, inductive bias and model error.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL eval discipline and model-vs-reality separation.
theory_families.disagreement: Empirical benchmark success is not global truth or causal understanding.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not treat learned representation as ontology without independent evidence.

theory_families.title: Artificial neural networks and deep learning
theory_families.external_lineage: Hopfield, Hinton and modern deep-learning research
theory_families.intersection: Distributed representation, learned features and nonlinear function approximation.
theory_families.harmonization: Can inform BL distributed intelligence while preserving implementation differences.
theory_families.disagreement: ANN success does not establish equivalence with biological cognition.
theory_families.non_merge: Neural terminology does not create brain-level identity.

theory_families.title: Probability theory and statistical inference
theory_families.external_lineage: Measure-theoretic probability, frequentist and Bayesian statistical traditions
theory_families.intersection: Uncertainty representation, evidence update and calibrated prediction.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL uncertainty only when priors/likelihoods or sampling models are defined.
theory_families.disagreement: Unknown ontology cannot always be reduced to probability over a known sample space.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not fabricate probabilities for underformalized unknowns.

theory_families.title: Dynamical systems and chaos theory
theory_families.external_lineage: Nonlinear dynamics, stability, bifurcation and chaos theory
theory_families.intersection: Attractors, sensitivity, regime changes and state-transition structure.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful for BL trajectory/worldline modeling with explicit dynamics.
theory_families.disagreement: 'Chaos' in ordinary language is not mathematical chaos.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not claim strange attractors or Lyapunov behavior without a defined system.

theory_families.title: Causal inference frameworks
theory_families.external_lineage: Potential-outcomes, structural-causal-model and experimental-design traditions
theory_families.intersection: Separates association, intervention, counterfactual and identification assumptions.
theory_families.harmonization: Strong discipline for BL causal-history claims and Reality tests.
theory_families.disagreement: A causal graph is a model, not Reality itself.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not infer causation from semantic or temporal adjacency alone.

theory_families.title: Game theory and strategic interaction
theory_families.external_lineage: Mathematics, economics and strategic-decision theory
theory_families.intersection: Multiple agents, incentives, equilibrium and coordination conflict.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL coordination modeling when payoffs/strategies are explicit.
theory_families.disagreement: Human institutions are not necessarily equilibrium-solvers and utility models may omit important values.
theory_families.non_merge: Do not reduce social truth or ethics to strategic equilibrium.

theory_families.title: Network science
theory_families.external_lineage: Graph theory, statistical physics, sociology and complex-systems research
theory_families.intersection: Topology, centrality, diffusion, modularity and robustness.
theory_families.harmonization: Useful for BL lineage/claim/knowledge graphs.
theory_families.disagreement: Graph topology alone does not establish semantic or causal equivalence.
theory_families.non_merge: No edge should gain causal meaning solely from co-occurrence.

theory_families.title: Decision theory under uncertainty
theory_families.external_lineage: Statistics, economics, operations research and behavioral decision science
theory_families.intersection: Actions selected under uncertainty, utility, risk and information value.
theory_families.harmonization: Supports BL portfolio/verification routing with explicit value assumptions.
theory_families.disagreement: Real human preferences may violate simple expected-utility models.
theory_families.non_merge: Optimization objective must not be mistaken for objective moral value.

emergent_lineage.title: Scope-Bounded Strength / Open-Totality Synthesis
emergent_lineage.collision: Strong domain theories can support very high confidence inside scope while leaving global ontology open.
emergent_lineage.new_delta: Treat maturity and openness as orthogonal axes rather than opposites in BL synthesis routing.

emergent_lineage.title: Instrument-Expanded Reality Surface
emergent_lineage.collision: New instruments do not merely add data; they create newly addressable observation surfaces and new downstream questions.
emergent_lineage.new_delta: Model capability growth as expansion of testable Reality interfaces distinct from expansion of Reality itself.

emergent_lineage.title: Representation-Prediction-Intervention Gradient
emergent_lineage.collision: Mapping, predicting and intervening are distinct capability thresholds even when they share representations.
emergent_lineage.new_delta: Require BL objects to declare which capability threshold they actually cross.

emergent_lineage.title: Formal-Limit / Ontology-Limit Separation
emergent_lineage.bl_parent: UNKNOWN + current representation boundary not equal reality boundary
emergent_lineage.collision: A limit proved inside a formal model is not automatically a limit of physical or ontological reality, while an unknown ontology is not automatically a computability problem.
emergent_lineage.new_delta: Route limits by class: formal impossibility, resource intractability, measurement insufficiency, model insufficiency, or ontology unknown.
